title: MMO of my dreams... Making a unique movement shooter / directional combat game
author: Longjumping_Form9922
selftext:
Hey Everyone!

Game title - Hook'd

I'm building a unique first person movement shooter (CS like movement bhop, surf, w strafes etc. all easier versions, Grappling hook) / directional combat MMO game. Its live at all times at [https://hookd.lol](https://hookd.lol/) You do not need a real email to test. You can put whatever for your login. No verification is needed. I HATE mounts, and driving in keyboard games. I wanted to create something that had such fun movement, you could traverse the entire world without feeling like its a bother to do so.

The main premise is you have a grappling hook attached to your arm, you've awoken in a strange desert town, and you need to fight, gather, quest, explore, and gamble, until you can buy your freedom from the 4 Pharaohs, who have been awoken, and now run a casino of disgruntled dealers who have been tipped poorly, the casino will always take the 1 dollar chips from your winnings, to cover their distress, since you weren't going to tip them anyway...

Its currently in a super alpha version, but there is a ton in the game to do. It contains a movement system that has never existed, and includes tons of different mechanics for skills, leveling, and general world exploration. I update it about 20 times a day, so sometimes it'll be broken, sometimes itll need a quick optimization pass, but most times, the game works, and its always running on the site.

Here is a full list of everything implemented.

Open World - Quests, exploration, skill farming, chat lobby. Full bank and inventory system.

Casino - Actual vegas table games and slots. I am from vegas, and have spent quite a bit of time in casinos from my time here, and wanted to create an authentic vegas experience with the gambling.  
PVP Modes / Open world PVP - Survival/Extraction game mode that procedurally changes daily, including building, stations, double exp in PVP areas, and soon to be raiding! Every map has NPCs that you can pay 10k coins to, and they will run your loot to your bank, so you can stay on map with your base. When you leave the survival server, everything on map that you have is destroyed. But you can also delete everything and leave with your materials.

Extraction Tomb - Large maze, each player has their own client side extraction on the opposite side of the maze, all of the best loot is in the middle. There are roaming mobs and defending mobs. As people leave, their loot will respawn, and each server lasts 20 minutes.

Open World PVP - SWORD ONLY / DIRECTIONAL COMBAT - you can go off of any edge of the map, and enter the wilderness. Here youll be able to fight other players using the directional combat system, and farm the resources in the zone. Most PVP zones contain higher tier farmables, and loot. The game will be balanced in a way where a player who is low level, will still have a fighting chance against players with better gear, and more knowledge, if they use their skills, movement, and player ability, to out skill their opponents.

Skill progression \[Any Skill that requires a tool, is already in your hot bar permanently, just press 3 when walking up to farmable areas\]  
\- Marksman  
\- Swordsmanship  
\- Flying  
\- Mining  
\- Fishing  
\- Cooking  
\- Armor Crafting  
\- Metallurgy  
\- Engineering  
\- Wood Cutting  
\- Farming  
\- Gambling  
\- Swimming  
\- Construction  
\- Ore Extraction

Automation - There is a player home system (Similar to runescape home portals) Where you can build your personal plot however youd like using the free building system, then you can add automation to your base. The goal is to be able to go home, throw everything you farmed in 1 box, and have your machines craft everything you need.

To do this efficiently, you will need to level your mining, wood cutting, OR fishing, to level 90, which you will then unlock a power generator, so your machines will always continue to run

There is a global market, shared between all servers, and 2 ingame currencies, neither of which can be bought for real money. Coins can be bought with credits, or credits can be bought with coins. As the casino wins more, the price of coins goes up. As the players win more, the price of credits goes down. You need credits to roll for custom skins, all of which have 1000 different patterns.

If you're not a gambler, you can choose to buy untradeable skins, in whatever pattern and skin you want, and you'll be refunded 25% of your purchase, to buy anything else you may want. This is not currently working with actual paid purchases, but is implemented. If i see you in game, ill give you credits to roll for skins anyway until release!

Fishing has atleast 1500 different catchable fish. 8 tiers of rods, 8 tiers of fish, 9 fish in each tier, all needing be caught in different locations, each fish itself, has its own unique coloring, and saves in your fish log. If you catch one you really like, you can pay 10k coins to put it on a t shirt, and wear your favorite fish

Questing - Trying to make unique and memorable quests that people will enjoy. There will never be a "gather 10 of these then talk to this guy" quest. Which is another thing I envy runescape for taking the time to do.

The plan is to port it over to steam this week, which will then have a request access prompt for more testers.

The goal is to optimize it to a point where 60 players fighting over an objective can be maintained, but to do that, I need more play testers!

This is a unique game for 1 sole reason, I am creating it BY PLAYING IT. however you feel about AI, I would not fault you for not wanting to play. I've spent 4.8 billion tokens already, and plan to spend atleast another 6 billion more. I wish i could animate, I wish I could code. Every system, every NPC, every creative decision, is in my own words to my robot friend, who then implements a shit version, that I change 10+ times until I feel its in a state that works, is fun, and optimized.

Having said that, again, I spend 12 hours a day playing this game, and making 20+ changes each day to systems, looks, maps, etc. The code is AI, but the funny voice lines, the way things look, the amount of verbal sculpting I've done to make the game feel human, the long typed individual quests, the mechanics of each one that is implemented so far. Everything is my idea, that has been turned into code. I wish I could describe how much money has been spent describing how hands work to a robot. All in all, it is still just a concept of a game. I've already added tons of my own sounds, music, etc, but over time, the goal is to add all human created assets, sounds, models, etc.

If you made it this far, thanks for reading! I've been a competitive gamer for 25 years and my friends would describe me as a "Casual Sweatlord" I LOVE games with unique mechanics, and competitive games, but I wanted a game where the sweatlord, the guy on his phone that loves keno, or people that love the different colors and types of fish, can all have the same amount of content to enjoy, in completely different circumstances. This is such a cool personal project for me because every game that has ever been developed, goes through development, then testing. I am in a unique situation where every single interaction, is being tested by someone who is obsessed with mechanics, and each piece gets completely shaped by each interaction I come in contact with. I unfortunately am not a developer by trade. I have tried to develop 4 other failed versions of this vision, and every time, the multiplayer has been the issue. Fortunately, that is not the case this time.

In the future, it will cost 3 dollars on steam, no matter how good it looks, or how much server hardware I need to purchase / rent. There will not be a subscription, there will not be a "Members only" section. I want people to enjoy the things I enjoy, not tax them for playing.

If anyone has any questions, or tries it, and has feedback, feel free to post it here! Ill read it all eventually. If you see me in game say hi, and ill hook you up with some free money to gamble, and some free credits for skins. Even if you just want to swing around, feel free! That's really why I made it. To be able to play with my favorite mechanic in all of gaming on a website easily.
